issues: React warning: 'Each child in a list should have a unique key prop' in AdminHub render — cosmetic, not blocking. Consider adding key={} on the list of admin cards.

action_items: OPTIONAL cosmetic: add missing React key prop in AdminHub.jsx admin-card list to silence console warning.
critical_code_review_comments: rc_admin.py: excellent granular permission model (14 perms; founder gets all, support_admin/moderator get read-only). Every mutation goes through _require_reason (min 5 chars) → _audit(before,after,reason) — no silent balance changes.
Vault adjust idempotency: idempotency_key stored on the txn doc via a unique index; DuplicateKeyError caught → returns duplicate:true without re-applying $inc. Race-safe.
Negative adjust and reverse both use conditional atomic update ({vault_balance: {$gte: -delta}}) so vaults can never go negative — verified with 409 test.

settings PATCH is prospective-only (does not retroactively rebill), and every change writes to responsibility_center_settings_history with previous/new + admin identity + reason. Version increments monotonically.
Admin-driven reactivation (_admin_reactivate) mirrors owner reactivation exactly (atomic vault decrement + status flip + txn + notification) so admin retry-renewal is safe and idempotent.

Paused-member dashboard branch (services/responsibility_center.py L687–L699) correctly strips center to safe subset (id/name/type/status/vault_balance) and returns paused_notice — no leakage of members/activity/vault_transactions. Verified via read of the code path; owner and active-member dashboards preserve full payload.
Enforcement side-effects verified end-to-end: vault_frozen + fund → 409, invitations_locked + invite → 409, center paused + invite → 409 (but funding still works — recovery path preserved).
Minor: rc_admin_action() reads before-state only for the fields being mutated (dict comprehension over sets). Good — small audit payloads.

Minor: transactions/{txn_id}/reverse restricts to a whitelist of reversible types (vault_fund/seat_charge/seat_renewal/seat_reactivation/admin_adjustment) — sensible; not reversing renewal_attempts/notifications.
